pages.text: Check your keys here, not on a wiki — every key on these pages renders live from your current bindings, so this list stays correct even after you rebind.$(br2)Out of the box, 420+ mods registered $(bold)339 keybinds$() with $(bold)161$() of them colliding. The pack ships curated defaults that resolve the worst conflicts so casters and martial classes don't fight their own keyboard.

pages.title: Unbound By Design
pages.text: Some niche keybinds ship unbound to clear conflicts — they still work once you assign a key in the controls menu:$(br2)$(bold)Voice Chat$() — opt-in$(br)$(bold)AdHooks$() (grappling) — was hijacking mouse/Space/Shift/Ctrl$(br)$(bold)Occultism Backpack$() — use Sophisticated Backpacks instead$(br)$(bold)Deeper & Darker Transmit$(), $(bold)More Artifacts$() eyes, $(bold)Botania Corporea Request$() — niche$(br2)Mods that drifted onto the caster keys above were likewise unbound.

pages.title: Context-Scoped Overlaps
pages.text: Some keys appear on more than one ability $(italic)but only ever fire one at a time$() because the game is in different states:$(br2)$(bold)JEI keybinds$() — only with the JEI overlay up$(br)$(bold)JourneyMap fullscreen keys$() — only inside the map UI$(br)$(bold)Jade$() (numpad) — only when the tooltip is showing$(br)$(bold)Crafting Tweaks$() — only inside crafting screens$(br)$(bold)Trash Slot$() — only inside your inventory$(br2)These look like collisions in the controls menu but won't fight each other in play.

pages.title: Customizing
pages.text: The bundled defaults are a starting point, and your own changes survive pack updates — the pack only fills in defaults when $(thing)options.txt$() is freshly created.$(br2)$(bold)Next: open Options → Controls and type a mod's name in the search bar$() — it filters the list to just that mod's keys. Bind your favorites from the Unbound page while you're there.
